name: Tsukumo no Tsuki
source:
Keita lived together with his weak imouto Maya while being supported by their relatives. He didn’t have any memories prior to his childhood accident, but otherwise he’s enjoying his life. Lately he often had a strange dream about a girl dressed in white – a dream which seemed to grip his heart tightly. One day at Maya’s suggestion, they headed to a place they’ve been to in the past, which he didn’t remember due to his accident. They reached a small shrine on a hill where a mysterious girl named Tsukumo appeared. She embraced him and said, “I’ve been waiting, onii-chan”.

[Edited from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/02/05/february-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
大羽庆太与体弱的妹妹摩耶共同生活，由亲戚提供帮助。他不记得童年事故发生前的事情，除此之外，日子过得相当愉快。最近，他经常梦见一名身穿白衣的女孩，那场梦仿佛紧紧攫住了他的心。

某天，在摩耶建议下，两人前往以前到过的地方。庆太因事故失忆，对那里毫无印象。他们抵达山丘上的小神社，神秘女孩ツクモ突然出现。她抱住庆太说道：“我一直在等你，哥哥。”

[根据 [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2012/02/05/february-2012-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]修改]
